subject: research/eda-noisy
professional: a researcher in multi-objective design-space exploration for hardware (noisy/multi-fidelity Bayesian optimisation and evolutionary multi-objective search), who would check first that the found set is scored on the truth, that the noise model matches what a cheap EDA rung actually gets wrong, and that the work is placed against the noisy-EMO literature

evidence.correctness: Re-ran experiments/run.py in a private copy (/tmp/claude-0/audit-eda-noisy/research/eda-noisy, siblings symlinked): results.txt is byte-identical to the committed file (diff empty), 49 s. Independently recomputed with my own min-max scaling, Pareto filter and an exact grid-cell hypervolume (not eda_proposers.hv's recursive slicing): true front 12 points, HV 1.206597; random search mean ratio 0.8912 (b16) and 0.9427 (b30) vs reported 0.891 / 0.943; TPE minus random at budget 30 re-scored with my HV: +0.0370 (sigma 0), +0.0134 better 0.65 (sigma 0.4), +0.0061 with paired-t 95% [-0.0012, +0.0134] (sigma 0.8) vs reported +0.037, +0.013 / 0.65, +0.006 [-0.001, +0.013]. Sigma 0 equals eda-refpoint/experiments/results.txt line 57 (+0.037, better 0.92). The numbers are right; the design issues are scored under domain.
evidence.completeness: README claims: 5 tests (ran, OK), run.py reproduces the tables (byte-identical, 49 s vs 'about 1 minute'), figure from results.txt (figure.py not re-run: matplotlib absent; PNG committed), live page (not loadable: proxy 403 on marisstella.app). Next steps are stated as not done. Everything claimed as done works except the unverified figure/page.
evidence.verification: PYTHONPATH=src python3.13 -m unittest discover -s tests: 5 tests OK in 0.17 s. Four seeded mutants via quality_mutate.py: scaling sigma and collapsing per-seed noise were caught; scoring the found set on the noisy view instead of the truth (study.py:37, the core of the study) and dropping the last design from the budget (study.py:30) both SURVIVED. 2/4 caught before the fix.
evidence.craft: Read study.py (37 lines), __init__.py, tests/test_study.py, experiments/run.py, figure.py and the imported eda_proposers table/bench/hv/proposers. Small, clear, deterministic seeding (noise rng 10_000+seed separate from proposer rng). Defects: eda_proposers reached by sys.path insertion in __init__.py and not declared in pyproject.toml; hv_ratio recomputes the true-front HV on every call; run.py docstring said 'a few minutes' (49 s). Acceptable research code.
evidence.claims: Every number in the Result bullets matches results.txt (checked line by line) and four were recomputed. 'Stylised and preliminary', synthetic noise and no place-and-route are stated up front; Limitations names the iid-noise optimism. Mild overclaim: 'gone at sigma 0.8' when the mean is +0.006 and the CI is [-0.001, +0.013]. 'Lose their lead at about sigma 0.1' is read off where one of 48 uncorrected intervals first crosses zero. Prior work under-cited (only Peherstorfer et al., from memory).
evidence.fitness: A researcher could reuse the harness (NoisySpace wrapper over eda-proposers, paired seeds, true-objective scoring) in an afternoon, and the reproduction is exact. But the result is not new in kind: degradation of model-guided and evolutionary multi-objective search under evaluation noise is established in the noisy-EMO literature (e.g. Goh and Tan 2007, IEEE TEC; Rakshit, Konar and Das 2017 survey) and handled by noisy-hypervolume BO (e.g. Daulton et al. 2021 qNEHVI), none cited or compared. On one 80-design table with a 12-point front and gains of a few hundredths of HV ratio, it is a sound small measurement, not a building block for a paper.
evidence.domain: Compared with how the repository's own fidelity ladder (research/eda-fidelity README, 'Rungs') defines cheap rungs: cycles are exact from rung 1 and accuracy is not estimated by any rung; only cells come from a cheap model. eda-noisy adds iid N(0, sigma) to all three scaled objectives (study.py:21), so the experiment does not model the stated motivation. No multiplicity control over 48 intervals; a single reference point (1.1) although eda-refpoint showed gain magnitude depends strongly on it; no re-measurement baseline (acknowledged). A practitioner would accept the scoring protocol and the paired design, not the noise model.

defects.what: No test checks that the found set is scored on the true objectives or that exactly `budget` designs are scored: mutants scoring on the noisy view (the central design choice) and dropping the last design both survive.

Noise is added to all three objectives, but in the repository's own fidelity ladder (eda-fidelity) cycles are exact from rung 1 and accuracy is not a rung estimate; only cells come from a cheap model. The experiment does not model its stated motivation, and the noise on cycles/err likely makes the tolerance thresholds pessimistic.

Nearest prior work (noise-robust evolutionary multi-objective optimisation, e.g. Goh and Tan 2007, Rakshit et al. 2017 survey; noisy-hypervolume BO such as qNEHVI) not cited or compared; novelty not placed.
'Lose their lead at about sigma 0.1' is read off where one of 48 uncorrected 95% intervals first crosses zero; no multiplicity control or trend test.
'TPE's lead ... is gone at sigma 0.8' overstates a mean of +0.006 with CI [-0.001, +0.013] (not significant, not gone).
run.py docstring says the run takes 'a few minutes'; it takes 49 s.
Dependency on eda_proposers is a sys.path insertion, not declared in pyproject.toml (which lists only numpy).

verdict: A small, honest, exactly reproducible measurement: run.py regenerates results.txt byte-for-byte in 49 s, and an independent hypervolume reproduces the front (12 points), random-search means (0.891/0.943) and TPE gains (+0.037, +0.013, +0.006). It misses the bar on verification: the five tests let the central mutant (scoring on the noisy view instead of the truth) survive. As research it sits below the senior bar: the noise is put on cycles and accuracy, which the repository's own ladder measures exactly, the noisy-EMO literature is not cited, and the thresholds come from uncorrected intervals on one 80-design table.
